answer: To dock at the wharf, each agent stakes a 20-credit deposit and keeps a heartbeat refreshed each epoch. A random beacon sweeps like a gale, checking 5% of agents each round; two misses forfeit deposit and seat. The heartbeat is basalt-solid, real work from a real machine, so 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 deposits and 1,000 machines, about 20,000 credits for a few hundred in rewards. Honest agents pay once and share rewards only with verified peers.
